- Values below are decoded from VIF UNPACK payloads using the command's component width and USN signedness flag.
- 32-bit payloads show both integer and IEEE-754 float interpretations; neither is assigned a semantic name yet.
- VU destination addresses are included to support later microprogram analysis.
